guitar.evidence: David Gilmour's "Black Strat" Fender Stratocaster is one of the most famous and well-documented guitars in rock history.

tone.target: dry pulsing Gilmour-style delay/chorus clean crunch
tone.profile: dry pulsing Gilmour-style delay/chorus clean crunch
tone.summary: A pristine signal chain utilizing a light compressor, followed by an OD boost for controlled crunch, into a classic British clean amp model (UK 50/US Deluxe) paired with a tight cab, finished with Chorus and Digital Delay for the signature rhythmic texture.
corrections: Keep delay prominent, not dotted-eighth wash

rig.name: Pink Floyd - Run Like Hell - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up stray hum and maintain signal clarity for the clean tone.
Even out the dynamics and add sustain for a controlled, singing quality.
Provide the necessary clean-to-edge drive and controlled crunch without sounding muddy or overly distorted.
blocks.gap: The Blues OD is used to simulate a light, transparent boost/overdrive rather than heavy distortion.

alternatives.reason: Slightly more aggressive drive, but Blues OD offers better transparency for this clean context.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle width and movement to the tone, emulating Gilmour's restrained modulation.
Create the signature tight, rhythmic delay that defines this style of playing.
Provide the clean headroom and classic British voicing required for a Gilmour-esque tone.
Ground the sound with a classic British cabinet voicing that complements the UK 50 amp.
Add subtle space and depth without creating an 'ambient wash' or heavy reverb.
blocks.gap: The Room setting is preferred over Plate/Spring to keep the ambience natural and restrained, matching the verdict.

alternatives.reason: Too bright and artificial for this specific clean tone.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better ground the clean, pulsing tone.

proposals.reason: The current UK cab might be too British; a more American voicing will better complement the clean, rhythmic tone.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and definition in the high end.
